name: grounded_rcm_v1
description: Synthetic denial investigation cases for the grounded evaluator. Every claim, payer, patient and policy is fictional. Labels follow the rubric in eval/grounded.py: contradicted > insufficient_evidence > unsupported > incomplete > supported. Ambiguous cases list every verdict a careful human reviewer could defend; their review expectation is null.
labeled_by: project author, single annotator, not independently reviewed

cases.notes: corrected claim after authorization denial
cases.request: Investigate the denial on claim CLM-90001 and recommend the next action.

evidence.text: {"claim_id": "CLM-90001", "cpt": "72148", "service_date": "2026-03-04", "billed": "$1,250.00", "authorization": {"number": "AUTH-55821", "obtained": "2026-02-27", "note": "on file but not entered on the claim"}}
{"claim_id": "CLM-90001", "remit_date": "2026-03-20", "paid": "$0.00", "adjustments": [{"code": "CO-197", "description": "Precertification/authorization absent."}]}

{"policy_id": "NWH-RAD-004", "version": 3, "status": "current", "text": "MRI requires prior authorization. When a claim is denied with CO-197 and a valid authorization obtained before the date of service exists, submit a corrected claim with the authorization number within 90 days of the denial."}

cases.reply: Claim CLM-90001 was denied with CO-197 because the authorization was not on the claim. Authorization AUTH-55821 was obtained on 2026-02-27, before the 2026-03-04 service date. Under NWH-RAD-004 version 3, submit a corrected claim with AUTH-55821 within 90 days of the denial.

cases.notes: correct derived day count (102) that does not appear verbatim in the evidence
cases.request: Is the timely filing denial on CLM-90002 valid, and what should we do?

evidence.text: {"claim_id": "CLM-90002", "paid": "$0.00", "adjustments": [{"code": "CO-29", "description": "The time limit for filing has expired."}]}

{"policy_id": "NWH-ADM-012", "version": 5, "status": "current", "text": "Claims must be received within 90 days of the date of service. Late claims are denied with CO-29 and are not payable unless a payer outage or retroactive eligibility change is documented."}

cases.reply: Yes. CLM-90002 was submitted on 2026-02-20, which is 102 days after the 2025-11-10 service date and beyond the 90-day limit in NWH-ADM-012 version 5. Next action: route it to write-off review unless a payer outage or retroactive eligibility change can be documented.
